verdict.rationale: The Dropbox Files API and official SDKs let a user list folders and read or download their files programmatically. Because Dropbox stores users' own files, those files can be pulled out through this route. But the evidence never documents a dedicated bulk export or takeout feature, or any way to export metadata such as sharing settings and version history in open formats. Missing for 10: documented bulk account-export/takeout tool, export of metadata (sharing, versions, comments) in open formats, account-deletion/offboarding guidance, independent confirmation of a clean exit path.
